versions.changelog:
Initial release of instagram-publish-tutor (v1.0.0):

- Guides users to publish single-image posts to Instagram via the Graph API using Creator or Business accounts.
- Includes one-time setup instructions for Meta App creation and access token generation.
- Provides step-by-step publishing instructions via a Python script.
- Documents common error messages and troubleshooting steps.
- Details requirements and limitations: public image URLs, no support for Stories/Reels/Carousels, and only for Creator/Business accounts.
